blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Short breaks help us have good ideas. Coffee, tea, water and sandwiches are the little things that get us through a long day.

Today we practise countable words and uncountable words. We say a sandwich or two sandwiches because we can count them. We say some coffee or some water because we cannot count them.

Today we learn five useful words and we do a lot of practice. Take your time — every sentence counts.

items.q: What do short breaks help us have?
items.why: "Short breaks help us have good ideas."

items.q: Which word do we count, one or two?
items.why: "a sandwich or two sandwiches" — sandwich é contável.

items.q: How many useful words do we learn today?
items.why: "Today we learn five useful words."

items.q: The text suggests that the writer wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: "Take your time — every sentence counts." O tom é calmo e apoiador.

items.q: The writer would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: Breaks are a waste of time
Coffee and tea help a long day
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que pausas curtas ajudam — não são perda de tempo.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emma na cozinha do escritório. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Come in, come in. This is our kitchen. We have breaks here every day. It is a nice place to stop and rest.

Do you want a coffee? There is some coffee in the pot. It is hot and fresh. I drink coffee every morning — it helps me start the day. If you like tea, we have some tea too. I like tea in the afternoon. Tea is calm and warm.

There is water on the table. Take some water — it is good for a long day. And here we have sandwiches. You can take a sandwich for lunch. We have chicken and cheese. Lunch is at noon, so it is a good time now. Do you want a sandwich?

We often have lunch together at this table. It is nice to talk and to rest a little. Short breaks help us a lot. After a break, I feel good and I work well.

So please, sit down. Help yourself. Have some water, take a sandwich, and enjoy your break with us!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where is Emma talking to you?
items.why: "This is the kitchen."

items.q: When does Emma drink coffee?
items.why: "I drink coffee every morning."

items.q: What can you take for lunch?
items.why: "You can take a sandwich for lunch."

items.q: Emma suggests that breaks are…
items.why: Inferência: "Short breaks help us… I feel good and I work well."

items.q: How does Emma feel about you being there?
items.why: Inferência: ela convida a sentar, comer e descansar — tom acolhedor.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Can I have some water, please?" Water is…
items.why: Water = água.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I have a ___ for lunch."
items.why: Sandwich é contável, então usamos "a sandwich".

items.q: "She likes tea in the afternoon." Tea is…
items.why: Tea = chá.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There is some ___ in the pot. It is hot."
items.why: Coffee é incontável; combina com "some" e com "hot in the pot".

items.q: "Lunch is at noon." Lunch is…
items.why: Lunch = almoço.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que ouvimos numa pausa no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please, help yourself to some coffee." This means…
options: Take it, it is for you
items.why: Help yourself = sirva-se, pode pegar à vontade.

items.q: "Let's take a break for ten minutes." To take a break means to…
items.why: Take a break = fazer uma pausa, descansar um pouco.

items.q: "Do you want to grab a coffee?" This means…
items.why: Grab a coffee = pegar/tomar um café, jeito informal.

items.q: "Let's have lunch together today." This means…
items.why: Have lunch together = almoçar juntos.

items.q: "Would you like some tea?" This is a polite way to…
items.why: Would you like…? = jeito educado de oferecer algo.
